nodes.text: ACT II — THE RIFT _ Calm settles over the retaken Bastion… then the earth groans, farther off, beyond the ridges. A rift tears open in the neighboring land, and the same corruption pours out. _ Two volunteers from the village join the squad: Kael, a seasoned guard, and Wren, a silent blade. Sorne draws her robe tighter. _ Sorne: I have felt this before. At the Hamlet. But here it rises from a source — a heart beating beneath the Rift. If we do not snuff it out, the whole land will warp.

The Lock has fallen. Beyond it opens the last land — where the Rift beats strongest.
_
We must reach the Heart and smother it.

At the heart of the Rift, the black mage collapses in one last flash. _ The corruption ebbs, slowly, like a tide drawing back. _ Sorne: It is out. For now. _ Kael: And the land breathes again. Let us head home — there are still fires to light back at camp. _ END OF ACT II.
